data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104 closed 2018 with a material prior-year release: gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were $72.606m and the notes show an over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses of $30.805m (a release). This reflects favourable development on prior years' claims. The syndicate's business is quota-share reinsurance (treaty) of Syndicate 33's property catastrophe account; Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (2017) were highlighted as the only significant catastrophe losses impacting recent years and were reserved at $36.2m.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary figures are reported in the accounts' native currency (USD). Field names use '_gbp_m' but amounts are in USD millions per the report. Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior-year development taken from Technical Provisions note 'Over-provision in respect of prior claims...' (gross figure). Claims development triangle is available (gross, in thousands) and was cross-checked against the movement note.
